//: FabMo .fma packaging manifest — what an installable on-tool build of Loom contains. A packager (ShopBot Labs serves one live at /apps/fabmo-loom/fabmo.fma) zips exactly these paths, rewrites the entry's ui_testbed theme links to the bundled ui/ copies, and writes a FabMo package.json pointing at `main`. Anything matching *.local.* (per-deployment guest mounts, funnel data) is excluded unconditionally by the packager, on top of the excludes here.
